event.name: 19 January 2026 · G4 geomagnetic storm onset
event.description: The severe G4 phase first reached at 19:38 UTC on 19 January, as reported by NOAA SWPC. T0 marks this onset, not the storm peak.

observation_source: NOAA SWPC native L1 density and GSM field, NASA SPDF hourly OMNI2 speed and indices. Sparse L1 hours remain missing. Observation timestamps mark interval starts.
input_source: Closed, unpropagated SWPC L1 hours drive density, IMF and the joint Kp/ap model. Density forecast gaps indicate missing recent L1 inputs. Kp/ap uses archived OMNI2 indices with assumed availability at Kp bin close +1 h, Dst hour start +2 h and F10.7 day start +48 h. Speed uses OMNI2 and the author-preprocessed PROSWIN archive, assumed available at image slot +1 h. This development replay uses revised archives and simulated availability.
